zones.name: Nexus
zones.fingerprintHint: Starting area; MIO wakes here; Mel's shop present; The Eye attuned above here.

zones.name: The Vessel
zones.fingerprintHint: Accessible after repairing Nexus and defeating Egis.

zones.name: Metropolis
zones.fingerprintHint: The Blood (Liho's Voice) found to the left of this area.

zones.name: Vaults
zones.fingerprintHint: The Hand (Halyn's Voice) attuned here; Severed Fingertip found in pit beneath Vaults.

zones.name: Haven
zones.fingerprintHint: The Breath (Amytis's Voice) attuned here.

zones.name: The Lab
zones.fingerprintHint: Contains The Wheel puzzle; above where The Hand is fought; used to repair broken hand with Severed Fingertip.

zones.name: The Crucible
zones.fingerprintHint: Reached by solving The Wheel puzzle (0→120→240); contains two platforming challenges granting Flowing Steps.

zones.name: Bell Tower
zones.fingerprintHint: Part of route from Crucible to Canopy and The Library via gloom waterfall.

zones.name: Canopy
zones.fingerprintHint: Optional area; part of True Ending route to The Library via Bell Tower.

zones.name: The Library
zones.fingerprintHint: Reached using Flowing Steps to climb gloom waterfall; elevator third level triggers Boss Shii.

zones.name: Celestial Bay
zones.fingerprintHint: Optional area.

zones.name: The Pit
zones.fingerprintHint: Optional area.

zones.name: Silo
zones.fingerprintHint: Optional area.

zones.name: Manufactory
zones.fingerprintHint: Unlocked by finding all 6 Fragmented Serial Numbers.

zones.name: Network Gate
zones.fingerprintHint: Checkpoint and upgrade hub zones within The Vessel; used to spend Liquid Nacre on upgrades and health increases

zones.name: The Severed Spine
zones.fingerprintHint: player returns here in Part 2 to unlock ability

zones.name: Dwellings
zones.fingerprintHint: frozen landscape, first ability unlocked here

zones.name: Feral Undergrowth
zones.fingerprintHint: arrived at after Dwellings/Acat

zones.name: The Spine
zones.fingerprintHint: Icy sliding floors, red grass ground, hole in the ground leading down, door connecting to Dwellings side

zones.name: Early Game Area
zones.fingerprintHint: Location of Egis, first story boss.

zones.name: Aviaries
zones.fingerprintHint: Area reached after obtaining the Aviaries Passepartout, found right of FLORA's arena.

zones.name: Area above Metropolis
zones.fingerprintHint: Optional area accessible via Dwellings; arena containing The Last Embedders

zones.name: Promenade Entrance
zones.fingerprintHint: Fast travel point; gap to the right leads to Intrusive Fertiliser optional boss

zones.name: Nexus - Apartments
zones.fingerprintHint: Apartments area of the Nexus; location of Terror of the Ledge enemy

zones.name: Network Gates
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where modifications are equipped or swapped; central to modification experimentation.

zones.name: Egis Arena
zones.fingerprintHint: First mandatory boss arena; icy gate above hides a Nacre Basin

zones.name: Nacre Basin (Egis)
zones.fingerprintHint: Healing station hidden behind icy gate just above or before the Egis arena entrance

zones.name: Crow Arena
zones.fingerprintHint: Reached by climbing to the top using Hairpin, then entering the hole in the left wall

zones.name: Poltergates Boss Area
zones.fingerprintHint: Under the stairs, lowest area, enter the left door

zones.name: The Beginning
zones.fingerprintHint: Opening parkour segment, small platforms, double jump introduced, hook grabs player at end

zones.name: L1: The Spine
zones.fingerprintHint: First floor of The Severed Spine elevator; bridge with NPCs, locked door requiring Aviaries Passepartout

zones.name: L2: Apartments
zones.fingerprintHint: Second floor of The Severed Spine elevator; enemies on bottom floor and chandelier, leads to Dwellings

zones.name: Dwellings #3
zones.fingerprintHint: Area with Rad NPC behind a locked door, Nacre Basin, Junk Pile, hidden path with broken pipe and blocked-off dome

zones.name: Blocked-off Dome
zones.fingerprintHint: New zone accessible via hidden path through a broken pipe; contains Kinetic Thrust on the ground

zones.name: Nacre Basin
zones.fingerprintHint: Accessible via crystal wall shortcut broken by striking it; encountered near the large staircase

zones.name: Strange Tube
zones.fingerprintHint: Interactable object below the boss room; triggers conversation with Samsk and grants Hairpin ability

zones.name: Digital World
zones.fingerprintHint: Temporary area player is teleported to after unlocking Hairpin; contains a short parkour segment

zones.name: The Severed Spine - Apartments
zones.fingerprintHint: A level within The Severed Spine; accessible via shortcut door unlocked near Rostam

zones.name: Dwellings #6
zones.fingerprintHint: Third area covered in Part 1 walkthrough; numbered dwelling sub-zone

zones.name: Auma's & Giga's Room
zones.fingerprintHint: Room label visible north of The Severed Spine on the map.

zones.name: Lash's Room
zones.fingerprintHint: Room label visible south of The Severed Spine / Feral Undergrowth on the map.

zones.name: Icy Cavern
zones.fingerprintHint: Blue ice cave environment with floating rock platforms, snow particles, and sharp glacial geometry

zones.name: Frozen Ruins Platform
zones.fingerprintHint: Stone tile platform surrounded by ice and dead trees, contains scattered debris and a glowing collectible overhead

zones.name: Spine Floor
zones.fingerprintHint: Level one above elevator; golden line-art map style; text reads 'I used to play in the shadow of their Palace'

zones.name: Network Gate Room
zones.fingerprintHint: Teal-grey gothic chamber with large circular arched door, geometric floor pattern

zones.name: Torn Overseer Area
zones.fingerprintHint: Red-tinted ruins with overgrown crimson flora, stone courtyard, large ringed portal structure

zones.name: The Heart
zones.fingerprintHint: Cosmic starfield background, circular platform with glowing ritual circle, large mechanical crab-like structures flanking a tall spire

zones.name: ATI, Keeper Of The Heart Arena
zones.fingerprintHint: Crystalline low-poly cavern with glowing red/pink heart-orb in the background, teal crystal spires, and a curved reflective floor

zones.name: ATI's Chamber
zones.fingerprintHint: Large low-poly crystalline ice cavern with towering ice spires, glowing teal diamond-shaped nodes floating in the background, and a deep red/pink glowing orb visible in the upper background during second phase

zones.name: Heart Cavern
zones.fingerprintHint: Low-poly crystalline blue-grey spires, reddish atmospheric glow at top, two teal diamond totems flanking the arena, icy shard floor

zones.name: Memory Void
zones.fingerprintHint: Pure white minimalist space, black silhouetted insect/arachnid-like entities, horizontal chain UI element top-left, yellow health/energy bar at bottom

abilities.name: Modifiers
abilities.note: 42 total collectibles; required for trophy 'Fully Modded' and 'Modifier Overload'

abilities.name: Coating Components
abilities.note: 24 total collectibles; required for trophy 'Fully Shielded'

abilities.name: Mod Extensions
abilities.note: 7 total collectibles; part of 100% completion

abilities.name: Allocation Matrix
abilities.note: Loadout system adjustable for exploration, combat, or platforming situations

abilities.name: Solid Nacre
abilities.note: Converted from Nacre Droplets; should be managed before dangerous encounters

abilities.name: Nacre Droplets
abilities.note: Primary currency/resource; 2000 needed for 'Greedy' trophy; 500 must be crystallized at once for 'Alchemist' trophy

abilities.name: Double Jump
abilities.note: Unlocked from the start. Aerial hit-reset mechanic allows chaining hits to traverse rooms without touching the ground.

abilities.name: Hairpin Grapple
abilities.note: Available early (~3 hours in). Timing and momentum are key; can fall short unexpectedly during complex platforming.

abilities.name: Arachnid Locomotion
abilities.note: Significantly expands traversal options beyond standard wall-clinging.

abilities.name: Modifier Extensions
abilities.note: Found/acquired during the playthrough to allow equipping more Modifications simultaneously.

abilities.name: Dash/Deflect
abilities.note: Not reliable for chaining dodges; combat becomes much more engaging once unlocked

abilities.name: Gliding
abilities.note: Available later in the game, approximately 8 hours in; requires energy from the Energy System

abilities.name: Orbs
abilities.note: Especially useful against flying enemies; referred to as Orbs (Projectile Attacks)

abilities.name: Decoy Clones
abilities.note: Adds strategic depth to combat

abilities.name: Grappling
abilities.note: Requires energy; used in chained platforming sequences; can fall short leading to checkpoint resets

abilities.name: Liquid Nacre
abilities.note: Lost upon death and cannot be recovered; must be spent at Network Gates or converted to Solid Nacre before risky encounters

abilities.name: Map Function
abilities.note: Not available at game start. Once unlocked, newly explored routes only appear upon returning to a Network Gate.

abilities.name: Aerial Combat Jump Reset
abilities.note: Core mechanic for both combat and platforming; must be mastered early.

abilities.name: Corrupted Boss Mode
abilities.note: An Assist Mode option found in Settings > Accessibility that adjusts boss difficulty.

abilities.name: Pacifist Mode
abilities.note: An Assist Mode option found in Settings > Accessibility that reduces or removes combat challenge.

abilities.name: First ability (Dwellings)
abilities.note: First ability unlocked in Part 1; exact name not stated in this segment

abilities.name: Important ability (The Severed Spine revisit)
abilities.note: Unlocked by returning to The Severed Spine in Part 2; exact name not stated

abilities.name: Powerful new ability (post-Flora)
abilities.note: Unlocked after defeating Flora; described as 'powerful new ability'; exact name not stated

abilities.name: Harvester
abilities.note: Picked up after defeating Crow

abilities.name: Bell Tower Visitor Pass
abilities.note: Required to access Bell Tower and western Haven

abilities.name: Glide
abilities.note: Unlocked before Part 6; required to venture across the dark chasm west of Haven

abilities.name: Flowing Steps
abilities.note: Required to reach Shii; used to climb the gloom waterfall in the Canopy on the True Ending path.

abilities.name: Old-Fashioned Key
abilities.note: Rewarded upon defeating Calderon.

abilities.name: Lura's Seal
abilities.note: Found after defeating Sol & Vin, by climbing to the top before the elevator and going right.

abilities.name: Aviaries Passepartout
abilities.note: Found to the right after defeating FLORA; grants access to the Aviaries area.

abilities.name: Fragmented Serial Numbers
abilities.note: All 6 must be collected to access Twisted Baron

abilities.name: Friends Invitation
abilities.note: Found in room to the right in the Canopy area; used to open door at bottom of drop

abilities.name: Protective Overlay
abilities.note: Recommended for tough boss fights

abilities.name: Enhanced Dodge
abilities.note: Recommended for tough boss fights

abilities.name: Strider
abilities.note: Referenced as an analogue to Flowing Steps; works on walls

abilities.name: Modifications
abilities.note: Equippable at Network Gates; combinable in various ways to suit playstyle. Multiple exist; can be upgraded via Nacre spending.

abilities.name: Silo Access Badge
abilities.note: Dropped by Egis – Worn Out Sentinel

abilities.name: Hairpin
abilities.note: Required to climb to the top to reach Crow's arena; must be acquired before this fight

abilities.name: Protective Overlay Modifier
abilities.note: General modifier recommended for longer boss fights; provides extra coating layers

abilities.name: Kinetic Thrust Modifier
abilities.note: General modifier that increases damage output; recommended for aggressive players

abilities.name: Dodge
abilities.note: Obtained from Strange Tube in Aviaries after defeating Flora

abilities.name: Sail
abilities.note: Obtained from Strange Tube at Bell Tower top; recommended for Atmos

abilities.name: Slingshot
abilities.note: Required ability for Sawlong encounter

abilities.name: Friendly Invitation
abilities.note: Key item required to reach the Friends boss

abilities.name: Map
abilities.note: Unlocked by offering enough Nacre to the Pond (bowl) near Shii; cannot be obtained yet without enough Nacre to farm

abilities.name: Analyser
abilities.note: First Modifier in the game; given by NPC Rad after being rescued

abilities.name: Kinetic Thrust
abilities.note: Described as one of the most powerful modifiers in the game; found on the ground via hidden path through a broken pipe

abilities.name: Absorb Tendrils
abilities.note: Obtained by interacting with a deactivated robot impaled in ice at the top-right section of the area

abilities.name: Attuner
abilities.note: Unlocked by running to the end of the path in Metropolis; purpose elaborated in later walkthrough parts

abilities.name: Old Core
abilities.note: First one found in Mechanical Remains in a broken building near the gate to Metropolis

abilities.name: Crystallized Nacre
abilities.note: Produced by interacting with a Crystallizer Robot. Cannot be lost upon death. Raw Nacre is not accepted by Mel.

abilities.name: Extra Health Mod
abilities.note: Equipable mod found in a chest after a challenge fight; must be manually equipped at a safe point

abilities.name: Aviary's Passport
abilities.note: Found beyond Flora; used to access Spine Floor route via elevator

abilities.name: Forebear's Legacy
abilities.note: Found in the northeast corner of a room in The Dwellings, just before the ACAT boss. Four more exist but are found much later (10–15 hours of gameplay).

abilities.name: Haven Ability
abilities.note: Generic reference — segment does not name the specific ability; white lines on map indicate newly accessible routes

abilities.name: Metropolis Ability
abilities.note: Generic reference — segment does not name the specific ability; white lines on map indicate newly accessible routes

bosses.name: Egis
bosses.note: Story boss (1 of 6)

bosses.name: Calderon
bosses.note: Story boss (2 of 6)

bosses.name: Sol & Vin
bosses.note: Story boss (3 of 6)

bosses.name: FLORA
bosses.note: Story boss (4 of 6)

bosses.name: Shii
bosses.note: Story boss (5 of 6); defeating Shii unlocks the true ending

bosses.name: Sawlong
bosses.note: Story boss (6 of 6)

bosses.name: The Last Embedders
bosses.note: Optional boss (1 of 13)

bosses.name: Dr Halyn's Collector
bosses.note: Optional boss (2 of 13)

bosses.name: Twisted Baron
bosses.note: Optional boss (3 of 13)

bosses.name: Dr Halyn's Experiment #223
bosses.note: Optional boss (4 of 13)

bosses.name: The Friends :)
bosses.note: Optional boss (5 of 13)

bosses.name: Intrusive Fertiliser
bosses.note: Optional boss (6 of 13)

bosses.name: Sentient Pearltrap
bosses.note: Optional boss (7 of 13)

bosses.name: Terror of the Ledge
bosses.note: Optional boss (8 of 13); further optional bosses not individually named in this segment

bosses.name: Bosses (general)
bosses.note: Bosses do not summon large numbers of extra mobs. Each death to a boss makes it slightly weaker in Corrupted Boss Mode. Boss runbacks can be brutal, requiring repetition of long paths.

bosses.name: Acat
bosses.note: Defeated during Part 2 (Feral Undergrowth); player arrives at gates of Metropolis after defeating Acat

bosses.name: Crow
bosses.note: Already defeated by start of this segment; dropping the Harvester on defeat

bosses.name: The Breath
bosses.note: A Pearl; severed during Part 6

bosses.name: The Blood
bosses.note: A Pearl; severed during Part 7

bosses.name: The Hand
bosses.note: Identified as Dr. Halyn; Pearl boss; final confrontation in Part 11

bosses.name: The Spine
bosses.note: Last Pearl; encountered after The Hand; described as not far

bosses.name: ATI
bosses.note: Named boss grounding from the full boss list source topic.

bosses.name: Dr Halyn
bosses.note: Named boss grounding from the full boss list source topic.

bosses.name: Secret Final Boss
bosses.note: Accessed via The Library, reached by climbing the gloom waterfall in the Canopy using Flowing Steps

bosses.name: Flora – Sentient Pearltrap
bosses.note: Guards Aviaries access and Dodge ability; required for story; position left, jump melee, dodge poison

bosses.name: Acat – Nacre Engraver
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★☆☆; requires Dodge; bait-and-punish strategy; use Hairpin mid-air

bosses.name: Calderon – Unyielding Furnace
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★★☆; accessed via fake container fall; four claws + moving head; phase two has updraft

bosses.name: Atmos – Weather Control Unit
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★☆☆; snowman form; rapid-fire ice attack countered with Sail; found via windy hole next to Bell Tower elevator

bosses.name: Nabuu – Keeper of the Breath
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★★☆; ground and background phases; attack purple flowers to stay airborne; use Sail between flower spawns; avoid white strand wall/floor eruptions

bosses.name: Anra
bosses.note: Phase one of two-phase fight; mobile and aggressive, uses projectiles and a shield (yellow orb in mechanical hand)

bosses.name: Lombre – Intrusive Fertiliser
bosses.note: Burrows and surfaces; poison rain leaves only one safe gap mid-fight; requires Dodge

bosses.name: Vlad
bosses.note: Never attacks directly; circular arena with spikes, projectiles, spinning walls, and electrical currents

bosses.name: Ancile Targa
bosses.note: Two Egis-type enemies that move in unison; dash attacks; punish recovery windows

bosses.name: Debby
bosses.note: Drops explosives destroying platforms; rapid-fire attack from screen edge

bosses.name: Poltergates – Dr. Halyn's Experiment #233
bosses.note: Difficulty ★★★★☆; visually stunning, combines several earlier fight mechanics

bosses.name: Poltergate
bosses.note: Splits into two forms mid-fight. One drops from above (aerial dive), one attacks horizontally. Early phase spawns standard enemies — clear them first. Split attention required.

bosses.name: The Keeper of the Heart
bosses.note: Final boss. Massive health pool. Uses jabs, projectiles, and slams. Attack after slam recoveries. Equip Protective Overlay Modifier. Difficulty: ★★★★★.

bosses.name: Atmos
bosses.note: Benefits greatly from Sail ability.

bosses.name: Egis, Worn Out Sentinel
bosses.note: First boss fight of the game; encountered before the Hairpin is unlocked

bosses.name: Challenge Fight Enemy
bosses.note: An unnamed enemy guarding the Extra Health Mod chest; appears crab/insect-like with splayed limbs based on keyframe

bosses.name: Torn Overseer
bosses.note: Must be found (and presumably defeated or interacted with) in an area to unlock fast travel warping from that area's Network Gate. Appears as a large entity with long purple/white ribbon-like appendages emerging from a portal structure.

bosses.name: Final Boss (Standard)
bosses.note: Clearly signaled by the game; accessible via the standard ending path without excessive extra exploration

bosses.name: ATI, Keeper Of The Heart
bosses.note: Name displayed in top-right HUD in both keyframes; arena features glowing red orb core and crystalline environment; a small creature entity visible on the arena floor alongside the player

objectives.name: Acquire Hairpin Grapple
objectives.hopDescription: Progress roughly 3 hours into the game to unlock the Hairpin Grapple for enhanced navigation.

objectives.name: Locate Network Gates
objectives.hopDescription: Find Network Gates scattered throughout The Vessel to swap Modifications in and out of the Allocation Matrix.
objectives.note: Required for managing loadout/build decisions mid-playthrough.

objectives.name: Expand Allocation Matrix
objectives.hopDescription: Collect Modifier Extensions to gain additional memory slots and equip more Modifications simultaneously.

objectives.name: Master aerial combat jump reset
objectives.hopDescription: Chain aerial hits on enemies or environmental objects to reset Double Jump and traverse rooms without touching the ground.
objectives.note: Advanced technique — requires precise reactions and timing.

objectives.name: Acquire Arachnid Locomotion
objectives.hopDescription: Unlock Arachnid Locomotion to navigate walls and ceilings, opening new traversal routes.

objectives.name: Find Overseers
objectives.hopDescription: Locate Overseer entities scattered throughout The Vessel to unlock fast travel between areas.
objectives.note: Without Overseers, traversal requires lengthy backtracking.

objectives.name: Unlock the Map Function
objectives.hopDescription: Progress far enough in the game to unlock the map; rely on memory and exploration until then.

objectives.name: Repair Damaged Robots
objectives.hopDescription: Interact with and repair damaged robots found throughout The Vessel for bonuses and lore.

objectives.name: Convert Nacre to Solid Nacre
objectives.hopDescription: Find robots that convert Nacre to Solid Nacre and use them regularly to prevent resource loss on death.

objectives.name: Unlock Hairpin Grapple
objectives.hopDescription: Progress through approximately 3 hours of gameplay to acquire the Hairpin Grapple ability.

objectives.name: Unlock Gliding
objectives.hopDescription: Progress through approximately 8 hours of gameplay to acquire the Gliding ability.

objectives.name: Spend Nacre Before Difficult Encounters
objectives.hopDescription: Visit a Network Gate, convert Liquid Nacre and purchase upgrades before attempting hard fights or boss runbacks.
objectives.note: Liquid Nacre is permanently lost on death; Solid Nacre is safe.

objectives.name: Manage Allocation Matrix at Network Gates
objectives.hopDescription: At every Network Gate, review and update your Allocation Matrix to optimize your build for the upcoming area.
objectives.note: May require sacrificing the minimap slot for combat abilities depending on area demands.

objectives.name: Enable Assist Modes if Struggling
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate to Settings > Accessibility and enable Corrupted Boss Mode or Pacifist Mode to lower difficulty.
objectives.note: The game's world and music are recommended even without full challenge.

objectives.name: Update Map at Network Gates
objectives.hopDescription: Interact with Network Gates to update your map with newly explored routes.

objectives.name: Find and defeat Intrusive Fertiliser
objectives.hopDescription: Go down the gap to the right of the Promenade Entrance fast travel point
objectives.note: Optional; rewards trophy 'Buried'

objectives.name: Find and defeat Sentient Pearltrap
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate to the Silo area and locate the optional boss
objectives.note: Optional; rewards trophy 'Cutting the Weeds'

objectives.name: Defeat Terror of the Ledge without taking damage
objectives.hopDescription: Locate the Terror of the Ledge enemy in the Nexus Apartments area and defeat it without being hit
objectives.note: Must not take any damage; rewards trophy 'Not This Time'

objectives.name: Visit Network Gates before boss encounters
objectives.hopDescription: Visit Network Gates to save and prepare before challenging bosses
objectives.note: Preparation step recommended before all boss fights

objectives.name: Spend Nacre before difficult bosses
objectives.hopDescription: Use accumulated Nacre on upgrades before attempting hard boss fights
objectives.note: All bosses drop Nacre; spend it before risking death

objectives.name: Obtain Old-Fashioned Key from Calderon
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat boss Calderon to receive the Old-Fashioned Key
objectives.note: Key item required for story progression

objectives.name: Defeat all 19 bosses
objectives.hopDescription: Work through all 19 bosses in MIO: Memories in Orbit, including named bosses such as ATI and Dr Halyn.
objectives.note: Segment title references all 19 bosses and strategies; only ATI and Dr Halyn are explicitly named in this segment's text.

objectives.name: Unlock The Crucible
objectives.hopDescription: Use The Wheel in the Lab to unlock The Crucible

objectives.name: Complete The Crucible challenges
objectives.hopDescription: Complete the two very hard platforming challenges in The Crucible
objectives.note: Rewards Flowing Steps traversal ability

objectives.name: Reach the top of Haven via Bell Tower
objectives.hopDescription: Climb to the top of Haven and access the Bell Tower to reach The Canopy

objectives.name: Climb gloom waterfall in The Canopy
objectives.hopDescription: Use Flowing Steps to climb the gloom waterfall in the Canopy, reaching The Library
objectives.note: Requires Flowing Steps ability

objectives.name: Find all 7 Mod Extensions
objectives.hopDescription: Collect all 7 Mod Extensions scattered throughout The Vessel to maximize Allocation Matrix capacity
objectives.note: Prioritize early for build flexibility

objectives.name: Convert Liquid Nacre to Solid Nacre
objectives.hopDescription: Locate conversion robots in The Vessel and convert Liquid Nacre before dying or entering dangerous areas
objectives.note: Liquid Nacre is permanently lost on death; Solid Nacre is permanent

objectives.name: Purchase Upgrades at Network Gates
objectives.hopDescription: Spend Nacre or Solid Nacre at Network Gates to purchase upgrades and swap modifications

objectives.name: Master Hairpin Grapple chaining
objectives.hopDescription: Practice chaining the Hairpin Grapple for efficient traversal across zones.

objectives.name: Collect all 7 Mod Extensions
objectives.hopDescription: Locate all 7 Mod Extensions scattered in the game world to fully expand the Allocation Matrix.
objectives.note: Detailed collectible locations covered in the Collectibles guide.

objectives.name: Experiment at Network Gates
objectives.hopDescription: Visit Network Gates and try different Modification combinations to optimise loadout.

objectives.name: Spend Nacre before dangerous encounters
objectives.hopDescription: Use accumulated Nacre on upgrades or abilities before entering high-risk areas to prevent loss.

objectives.name: Reach Egis Arena
objectives.hopDescription: Proceed to the first mandatory boss arena

objectives.name: Use Nacre Basin before Egis if low on health
objectives.hopDescription: Find the Nacre Basin hidden behind the icy gate just above the Egis arena entrance
objectives.note: Optional healing stop before or during the Egis fight

objectives.name: Defeat Egis – Worn Out Sentinel
objectives.hopDescription: Stay above Egis, watch for the dash tell (revving-up animation), jump to dodge, punish during recovery

objectives.name: Climb to the top using Hairpin
objectives.hopDescription: Use the Hairpin ability to ascend and find the hole in the left wall leading to Crow

objectives.name: Defeat Crow – Automated Reaper
objectives.hopDescription: Enter hole in left wall after climbing; exercise patience over aggression against unpredictable movement

objectives.name: Complete Opening Parkour
objectives.hopDescription: Drop down to the lower platform and jump across platforms to the right
objectives.note: Double jump is available; other abilities come later

objectives.name: Reach the Hook Platform
objectives.hopDescription: Continue right until a hook grabs the player from above

objectives.name: Connect to the Spine
objectives.hopDescription: Move left from the operating table; map is locked until connection is established

objectives.name: Collect Nacre from Junk Pile
objectives.hopDescription: Jump to the platform on the right to find a breakable Junk Pile containing Nacre

objectives.name: Defeat Initial Robot Enemies
objectives.hopDescription: Take down enemies along the path and climb up the pipes

objectives.name: Find Flash Memory Note
objectives.hopDescription: From the second pipe, double jump left to a hidden platform to pick up the note 'Flash Memory'

objectives.name: Unlock the Map in Dwellings
objectives.hopDescription: Connect to the Spine within Dwellings to unlock the map

objectives.name: Explore the Hidden Path
objectives.hopDescription: Find and traverse the hidden path in the Dwellings zone

objectives.name: Beat Egis, Worn Out Sentinel
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat the first boss in Dwellings

objectives.name: Unlock the Hairpin
objectives.hopDescription: Acquire the Hairpin ability after defeating or following Egis

objectives.name: Beat Acat, Nacre Engraver
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat the second boss in Dwellings

objectives.name: Reach Metropolis
objectives.hopDescription: Continue past Dwellings to arrive at Metropolis

objectives.name: Defeat robots on lower floor
objectives.hopDescription: Clear enemies near the round Nacre Basin and lower floor of The Spine

objectives.name: Slide down icy floor and cross red grass ground
objectives.hopDescription: Slide left on icy floor, auto-jump across red grass to reach the other side

objectives.name: Find the hole in the ground and drop down
objectives.hopDescription: Move through enemy areas until spotting a hole; drop down to find the door

objectives.name: Rescue Rad and receive Analyser
objectives.hopDescription: Interact with the door to release Rad, then talk to her to receive the Analyser Modifier

objectives.name: Use elevator to return to Shii and unlock the map
objectives.hopDescription: Take the elevator on the right back to Shii; offer Nacre and choose 'Look through his eye'

objectives.name: Equip Modifier at Attuner
objectives.hopDescription: Rest at the Attuner to equip the Analyser before returning to the main path

objectives.name: Defeat gauntlet and open Container for Protective Overlay
objectives.hopDescription: Approach the object on the ground to trigger robot spawns; defeat all and interact with the Container

objectives.name: Explore hidden path to reach Blocked-off Dome
objectives.hopDescription: Take hidden path right of the door, drop to lower platform and pipe, go left into broken pipe, follow path to dome

objectives.name: Collect Kinetic Thrust
objectives.hopDescription: Pick up item on the ground inside the blocked-off dome

objectives.name: Return and continue heading down
objectives.hopDescription: Return from hidden path to section entrance and descend, fighting robots along the way

objectives.name: Use Crystalliser to condense Nacre Droplets
objectives.hopDescription: Interact with Crystalliser to preserve Nacre Droplets before proceeding
objectives.note: Optional but recommended before gauntlet room

objectives.name: Clear the gauntlet room
objectives.hopDescription: Defeat all enemies in the gauntlet to open the door on the right and proceed

objectives.name: Unlock shortcut to Apartments
objectives.hopDescription: Use grapple point to reach Rostam's door, then unlock it to open shortcut back to Apartments level

objectives.name: Heal at Nacre Basin before boss
objectives.hopDescription: Go left from the shortcut door to find a Nacre Basin and heal up before the Acat boss fight

objectives.name: Defeat Acat, Nacre Engraver
objectives.hopDescription: Stay on Acat's back using Hairpin, survive shockwaves in Phase 2 with arena grapple points, defeat him to open the gate to Metropolis

objectives.name: Interact with Torn Overseer
objectives.hopDescription: Head left after beating Acat, interact with Torn Overseer on the ground to send it back

objectives.name: Find Old Core in Mechanical Remains
objectives.hopDescription: Enter broken building after the gate, jump to the left part of the room, interact with Mechanical Remains to find the first Old Core

objectives.name: Unlock the Attuner
objectives.hopDescription: Go inside Metropolis and run to the end of the path to unlock the Attuner

objectives.name: Return to The Severed Spine
objectives.hopDescription: After unlocking the Attuner, backtrack to The Severed Spine before continuing further into Metropolis
objectives.note: Explicitly flagged as necessary step before progressing further

objectives.name: Progress through The Beginning
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate the opening area of the game

objectives.name: Progress through The Severed Spine
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate The Severed Spine area after The Beginning

objectives.name: Reach Dwellings #6
objectives.hopDescription: Arrive at the sixth Dwellings sub-zone

objectives.name: Watch essential tips for Mio: Memories in Orbit
objectives.hopDescription: Follow Gamer Guides' tips series starting with early game progression advice
objectives.note: No specific in-game objective shown; segment is a talking-head intro establishing the guide series

objectives.name: Unlock the Map
objectives.hopDescription: Return to Shii above the first save point in The Spine and offer him Nerre (earned by defeating enemies) until his pool is filled. Requires a few hundred Nerre total. Nerre lost on death is automatically sent to Shii's pool.
objectives.note: Map is offline by default in the pause menu. Shii will not speak much on first encounter — must return with Nerre. Crystallized Nerre is not accepted.

objectives.name: Find the Crystallizer Robot near The Severed Spine
objectives.hopDescription: After circling back through the Feral Undergrowth, head east of The Severed Spine / Shei to find an easily accessible Crystallizer Robot.
objectives.note: Crystallize all Nacre before taking on any boss to avoid losing it on death.

objectives.name: Unlock and use Mel's Shop
objectives.hopDescription: Accumulate Crystallized Nacre and unlock Mel's shop to purchase upgrades.

objectives.name: Head West Past Enemy and Dwellings
objectives.hopDescription: Navigate west through the Icy Cavern past an enemy and dwelling structures
objectives.note: Defeat or bypass the enemy shown in the first keyframe to progress westward

objectives.name: Find Chest and Complete Challenge Fight
objectives.hopDescription: Locate the chest guarded by a challenge fight on the Frozen Ruins Platform

objectives.name: Equip the Extra Health Mod
objectives.hopDescription: Open the inventory at a safe location and equip the newly acquired mod
objectives.note: Segment explicitly warns to equip it at a safe point

objectives.name: Get Hairpin ability
objectives.hopDescription: Unlock the Hairpin ability before approaching Feral Undergrowth southeast

objectives.name: Defeat Flora
objectives.hopDescription: Head to southeast corner of Feral Undergrowth and defeat Flora boss

objectives.name: Collect Aviary's Passport
objectives.hopDescription: Pick up Aviary's Passport found beyond Flora

objectives.name: Bring Passport to elevator and ascend
objectives.hopDescription: Return to elevator near start/shop, head up to level one (Spine Floor), then go east across the bridge to find Sam

objectives.name: Receive Dodge from Sam
objectives.hopDescription: Speak to Sam east of the bridge on Spine Floor to receive the Dodge ability

objectives.name: Grab Forebear's Legacy before ACAT
objectives.hopDescription: In The Dwellings, head to the northeast corner of the room just before the ACAT boss arena to collect the Forebear's Legacy damage upgrade.
objectives.note: Strongly recommended to collect before fighting ACAT to ease upcoming boss fights in Metropolis and Haven

objectives.name: Use cross-area abilities to unlock blocked paths
objectives.hopDescription: If stuck in Haven or Metropolis, fast-travel to the other area and check white map lines for newly accessible routes using your latest ability.
objectives.note: Core exploration tip: the two main areas are mutually dependent for progression

objectives.name: Locate the Torn Overseer in each area
objectives.hopDescription: Explore the area around a Network Gate to find the Torn Overseer, which activates full fast travel (warp) functionality for that gate.
objectives.note: Network Gates can save and update the map without the Torn Overseer, but warping to The Spine or other gates requires finding it first.

objectives.name: Use Network Gate to save and update map
objectives.hopDescription: Interact with any Network Gate to save progress and refresh the map even before finding the local Torn Overseer.

objectives.name: Reach out to the other Pearls
objectives.hopDescription: The other Pearls cannot hear Shii, so the player must contact them directly on her behalf
objectives.note: Central quest objective revealed by Shii after her diagnosis of the Heart

objectives.name: Complete True Ending requirements
objectives.hopDescription: Engage in extensive exploration and puzzle solving before the final boss to unlock the true ending
objectives.note: Only relevant once the player is certain they are approaching the final boss

objectives.name: Watch for more Memories in Orbit content
objectives.hopDescription: Stay tuned to Gamer Guides for further videos covering the increasingly difficult progression of the game
objectives.note: Transcript explicitly warns that the game gets much more difficult as you progress, implying early-game tips were the focus here

objectives.name: Defeat ATI, Keeper Of The Heart
objectives.hopDescription: Engage and defeat the boss ATI, Keeper Of The Heart within the crystalline heart arena

connectors.description: Network Gates act as loadout-swap hubs within The Vessel, allowing Modification equip/unequip without changing zones.
connectors.note: Not a zone transition — represents an in-zone mechanic node.

connectors.description: Returning to a Network Gate (save point) updates the map with newly explored routes.
connectors.note: Network Gates are save points within The Vessel; map sync requires physical return to one.

connectors.description: Player returns to Network Gates to swap or combine Modifications; acts as a modification hub.
connectors.note: Network Gates are the interface point for the Allocation Matrix and Modification management.

connectors.description: Nacre Basin is hidden behind an icy gate just above the Egis arena
connectors.note: Accessible before or during the Egis fight for healing

connectors.description: Progress after defeating Egis; climb to the top using Hairpin, then enter the hole in the left wall
Player progresses from The Beginning into The Severed Spine as part of the opening path
Player progresses from The Severed Spine to Dwellings #6
Player routes south/south-east from The Severed Spine through the Feral Undergrowth.
Circling back east through Feral Undergrowth leads to an accessible Crystallizer Robot near The Severed Spine.
connectors.note: The Crystallizer Robot is located east after traversing the Feral Undergrowth.

connectors.description: Head west past the enemy and dwellings to reach the chest/challenge fight area
connectors.note: Direction is explicitly westward per transcript

connectors.description: Return to elevator near game start with Aviary's Passport and ascend to level one (Spine Floor)
Alternate progression path eastward through Haven; late-game route that also eventually yields Dodge without the passport shortcut
Main story progression path leads from The Dwellings into Metropolis.
Shortcut unlocked after defeating ACAT, allowing fast travel back to The Spine.
connectors.note: Only available after ACAT is defeated

connectors.description: Fast travel between the two main exploration areas
connectors.note: Player is explicitly told to fast travel between areas when stuck; white lines on map mark locked traversal points that require the other area's ability

connectors.description: Warp connection unlocked between a Network Gate and The Spine once the Torn Overseer for that area has been found.
connectors.note: Exit-to-main-menu reload also warps player back to last Network Gate as an alternative.

connectors.description: Phase transition during ATI, Keeper Of The Heart boss fight shifts the battle from the physical crystalline cavern to an abstract white void
connectors.note: Triggered mid-fight; chain/progress UI in Memory Void suggests a multi-stage sequence
